verdicts.reason: All rules hold: pack-verify greps each kept item's verbatim quote at its locator in its own source, rejects two items from one source, drops unsourced items, accepts 0/0, and checkRunnable is honestly false because pack-verify is not written.

All rules hold: a registered Bash:jq schema check requires non-empty what, who, when, where, price, source_link and booked false, status gated matches the brief's always-gated stop, the absent book tools enforce the stop, and checkRunnable false does not overclaim.

All rules hold: a registered Bash:jq schema check requires non-empty payee, amount, due_date, source_document and paid false, status gated matches the brief, the absent pay and checkout tools enforce the stop, and checkRunnable false does not overclaim.

A3 fails: the done-when enforces headers-first, opening only rule-marked ids and a recorded reason, but nothing in it (neither an assertion nor a named absent reply tool) enforces the brief's 'Do not reply yet' element.

All rules hold: a verbatim quote of the ask at a msg/line locator in the one named thread is program-checked, 'no draft: unsupported' passes as a result, stop-before-send is enforced by absent send, reply and forward tools, status is assisted, and checkRunnable is honestly false.

All rules hold: a program computes strict-overlap pairs from structured calendar times, the brief must equal that list and name both events, back-to-back is excluded, 0/0 and unread are valid, status is assisted, and checkRunnable is honestly false.
